01-geometry-clipmap.title: Geometry clipmap terrain
01-geometry-clipmap.why: Infinite ground at high near density, one draw
01-geometry-clipmap.match: geometry clipmap or nested-ring LOD · sub-10 cm inner spacing · one static mesh, one draw call

02-layered-wind-noise.title: Layered wind-anisotropic noise
02-layered-wind-noise.why: Dunes that look carved by weather, not isotropic fBm
02-layered-wind-noise.match: directional structure carved by a prevailing wind · sastrugi · lee-face asymmetry

03-deformation-buffer.title: Persistent deformation buffer
03-deformation-buffer.match: persistent and additive · never rebuild from a list of past events · trail that does not self-shadow is a failure

04-multi-scale-shading.title: Multi-scale snow / surface shading
04-multi-scale-shading.why: Detail that reads at dune, ripple, and grain scales
04-multi-scale-shading.match: detail at three tiling scales · surface detail legible at three distinct scales simultaneously

05-wrap-sss.title: Wrapped diffuse + cheap SSS
05-wrap-sss.why: The term that makes snow/skin look translucent
05-wrap-sss.seen: SNOWFLOW snow SSS, spell lights through berms
05-wrap-sss.match: this single term does more for reads-as-snow than almost anything else

06-sdf-blend-shell.title: SDF blend-shell characters
06-sdf-blend-shell.match: ragdoll-like primitives that look like one seamless body · mobile-performant tech-art solution

07-floating-origin.title: Floating origin + log depth
07-floating-origin.why: Large worlds without jitter and z-fighting
07-floating-origin.match: one world unit is one kilometre · floating origin · LOGD_* chunks

08-bake-vs-evaluate.title: Bake vs evaluate
08-bake-vs-evaluate.why: When noise is too expensive per pixel
08-bake-vs-evaluate.match: planets are baked, not evaluated · runtime shader is three texture taps

09-atmosphere-sky.title: Analytic atmosphere / sky
09-atmosphere-sky.why: Sun elevation that moves the whole look
09-atmosphere-sky.seen: SNOWFLOW Nishita LUT, Long Silence Rayleigh shell
09-atmosphere-sky.match: low warm sun · ambient strongly blue-shifted · elevation slider correctly drags horizon warmth

10-post-stack.title: Post stack + tonemap discipline
10-post-stack.why: TAA-ready polish without clipping snow white
10-post-stack.seen: SNOWFLOW, Long Silence, Claude of Duty
10-post-stack.match: blown-out white is the primary failure mode · TAA is essential

11-swept-mesh.title: Swept-mesh wake / ribbon VFX
11-swept-mesh.why: Coherent water/snow bodies, not particle mush
11-swept-mesh.match: wake is a swept mesh, not a particle effect · one curl parameter from bank to hanging lip

12-procedural-pbr.title: Procedural PBR texture forge
12-procedural-pbr.why: Zero art assets, tiled materials from noise
12-procedural-pbr.seen: Claude of Duty materials, Solebound leather
12-procedural-pbr.match: GPU texture forge · no art assets · periodic noise so everything tiles
